title: Design, synthesis and evaluation of acridone-2-carbohydrazide derivatives as p-AKT Ser(473) kinase inhibitors.
authors: Yadav, Tanuja T; Kumar, Maushmi S; Bajaj, Shalini; Yc, Mayur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子AKT激酶抑制剂的设计合成与活性评价，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aim: A series of benzylidene- and phenylethylidene-substituted acridone-2-carbohydrazide derivatives were designed, synthesized and evaluated for their cytotoxicity and response to p-AKT Ser(473). Methods: The structures of the synthesized compounds were confirmed by spectroscopic techniques and evaluated for AKT enzyme inhibition activities. Molecular docking and in silico absorption, distribution, metabolism, elimination and toxicity studies were also performed. Results: Compounds 8k, 8v and 9h demonstrated good cytotoxicity against breast cancer cell lines. Especially, compounds 8v and 9h exhibited remarkable inhibition, with IC(50) values of 1.75 and 2.40 muM, respectively. These compounds inhibited p-AKT Ser(473) more specifically than total AKT in a dose-dependent manner. Moreover, they caused G0/G1-phase cell cycle arrest and cell apoptosis. Conclusion: This study identified compound 8v as a potent p-AKT Ser(473) inhibitor.
abstract_zh: 目的：设计、合成了一系列亚苄基和苯乙亚基取代的吖啶酮-2-酰肼衍生物，并评估了其细胞毒性和对p-AKT Ser(473)的响应。方法：通过光谱技术确认了合成化合物的结构，并评估了其AKT酶抑制活性。同时进行了分子对接和计算机模拟吸收、分布、代谢、排泄及毒性研究。结果：化合物8k、8v和9h对乳腺癌细胞系表现出良好的细胞毒性。特别是，化合物8v和9h显示出显著的抑制作用，其IC(50)值分别为1.75和2.40μM。这些化合物以剂量依赖性方式更特异性地抑制p-AKT Ser(473)，而非总AKT。此外，它们引起了G0/G1期细胞周期阻滞和细胞凋亡。结论：本研究确定化合物8v为一种有效的p-AKT Ser(473)抑制剂。
